busy.where: Shown wherever a command fails with the busy error (any screen that shows an error line).
busy.approved: The Library is busy. Try again in a moment.

diskFull.where: Shown wherever a command fails because the disk is full.
diskFull.approved: Disk full. Free up some space and try again.

cannotWrite.purpose: Error: the app can't write to its data folder.
cannotWrite.where: Shown wherever a command fails because the app's data folder can't be written.
cannotWrite.approved: Can't save to the app's data folder (it may be read-only). Restart the app.

damaged.purpose: Error: the Library database is damaged.
damaged.where: Shown wherever a command fails because the database is damaged.
damaged.approved: The Library's database is damaged. Restart the app.

database.purpose: Error: the Library couldn't be read or saved (a general database failure).
database.where: Shown wherever a command fails with a database error.
database.approved: Couldn't read or save the Library. Try again.

stopped.purpose: Error: the Library's background thread has stopped.
stopped.where: Shown wherever a command fails because the Library has stopped.
stopped.approved: The Library has stopped. Restart the app.

internal.where: Shown wherever a command fails with an internal error, or an error the app doesn't know.
internal.approved: Something went wrong. Try again or restart the app.
